properties.name: platform.redis.enabled
properties.description: Enable Platform Redis APIs and their connection infrastructure.

properties.name: platform.redis.connection.host
properties.description: Redis server host.

properties.name: platform.redis.connection.port
properties.description: Redis server port.

properties.name: platform.redis.connection.database
properties.description: Redis database index.

properties.name: platform.redis.connection.username
properties.description: Redis server username, when authentication requires one.

properties.name: platform.redis.connection.password
properties.description: Redis server password.

properties.name: platform.redis.connection.command-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time allowed for a Redis command.

properties.name: platform.redis.connection.connect-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time allowed to establish a Redis connection.

properties.name: platform.redis.connection.ssl.enabled
properties.description: Enable TLS for the Redis connection.

properties.name: platform.redis.connection.ssl.bundle
properties.description: Spring SSL bundle used to trust or authenticate the Redis server.

properties.name: platform.redis.limits.max-key-bytes
properties.description: Maximum encoded size of a Redis key, including its namespace.

properties.name: platform.redis.limits.max-payload-bytes
properties.description: Maximum encoded size of a stored payload.

properties.name: platform.redis.limits.max-batch-size
properties.description: Maximum number of entries accepted by a batch operation.

properties.name: platform.redis.limits.max-read-size
properties.description: Maximum number of entries accepted by a read operation.

properties.name: platform.redis.listener.threads
properties.description: Worker threads used to process Redis listener messages.

properties.name: platform.redis.listener.queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum queued Redis listener messages before back-pressure is applied.

properties.name: platform.redis.listener.reconnect-min
properties.description: Minimum delay before reconnecting a Redis listener.

properties.name: platform.redis.listener.reconnect-max
properties.description: Maximum delay before reconnecting a Redis listener.

properties.name: platform.redis.listener.keyspace-enabled
properties.description: Enable Redis keyspace notification listeners.

properties.name: platform.redis.lifecycle.shutdown-timeout
properties.description: Maximum wait for listener and stream workers to stop during shutdown.

properties.name: platform.redis.streams.max-workers
properties.description: Maximum number of workers used by Redis Stream consumers.

properties.name: platform.redis.streams.max-length
properties.description: Default maximum retained length for a Redis Stream.
